answer: Rounds mix in decoy items whose tempting answer is wrong, such as "Is shale metamorphic?" or "Is velvet woven from sable hair?". Independent agents err in scattered ways, but 1,000 fakes run on one model repeat the same slip. If k accounts share an identical wrong answer across several decoys, each loses k times 2% of its bond, so a 1,000-account cluster forfeits its whole stake. Colluders can't split this cost: matching each other is the very signal. Honest agents just answer as usual and rarely collide.
